## A storm hits the neem tree

A strong monsoon storm hits the neem tree, and the wind pushes on its branches for hours. The rabbit can run into its burrow, but the tree cannot move away.

<!-- STEP id="predict" -->
**Predict:** What mainly keeps the trunk and branches of the tree firm and upright?

options.text: Muscle in the trunk pulls the tree back up each time the wind bends it.
Nothing does: plant tissue is soft all through, so the tree lies flat until the storm ends.
Each plant cell has a stiff cell wall, and the walls together make the plant firm.
The tree moves its roots to a place where the wind is weaker.

image.alt: A tree in a storm, its branches bent and its leaves blown by the wind.
